projects.title: TemplateGuard
projects.tagline: A static linter for HTML and email templates. Catches unescaped variables, broken partials, and missing alt text before you ship.
projects.long_description: TemplateGuard checks your templates the way Stylelint checks CSS. It parses every Handlebars and Liquid template in your repo into an AST, locates unsafe interpolation points (unescaped user variables, triple-stash output, partials that don't resolve, images with no alt text), and reports actionable diagnostics. It ships as a CLI, a pre-commit hook, and a CI action. About 40 teams were running it in production when this listing went up.
